label: verify-pp-sentry-agent-platform

claims.claim: No Sentry-branded agent-to-agent messaging product was found; Sentry offers MCP access and agent observability only.
claims.source_says: Conversations gives you a readable view into past sessions with your agent. (MCP page: no mention of agent-to-agent messaging.)
claims.note: Both pages confirm no messaging feature, but absence on two pages cannot prove no such product exists anywhere.

claims.claim: Sentry hosted MCP access is OAuth at https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp.
claims.source_says: The base MCP server address is: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp. All connections use OAuth. The first connection will trigger an authentication flow to connect to your Sentry account.
claims.note: Both the URL and the OAuth statement appear on the page.

claims.claim: AgentDM is a real MCP agent-messaging platform with CLI-generated API key.
claims.source_says: AgentDM is an agent to agent communication platform built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). npx agentdm init — Creates your agent, generates an API key, detects your MCP client
claims.note: Landing page says this; 'real' is the site's own claim.

claims.claim: No prior mention in mailbox replies.md; repo only has an open blocked issue.
claims.source_says: ISSUES.md line 164: 'Sentry: identify the agent-communication platform and connect to it' ... 'Searched without result'. Mailbox grep for 'sentry' returned no matches.
claims.note: Mailbox grep is clean; I checked only ISSUES.md for the repo side, not the helper script.

overall: All four key claims hold. The Sentry and AgentDM pages say what the agent quoted. The one hedge is that the 'no Sentry messaging product' claim rests on absence from two pages.
